policy: No posting in the 320-record dataset is relevant to these queries. 'unrelated' and 'nonsense' cases should ideally return nothing; 'out_of_coverage' cases name real student career areas the dataset does not contain (the closest postings are only loosely related). The current system has no relevance threshold, so this file measures what a student would be shown, not a pass/fail target.
